name.en: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar
name.ja: 甦るグールズ総帥 マリク・イシュタール

notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the course of the event:

rows.text: Card Sleeves: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar
Game Mat: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar
Title: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar Completed

notes: Additionally, after obtaining all of the above rewards, the player obtains 50 R Jewels for every additional 600,000 points they earn.

rows.text: Card Sleeves: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar
Game Mat: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar
Title: Return of the Leader of the Rare Hunters! Marik Ishtar Completed

notes: When Dueling against Marik Ishtar at Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
Arkana, Lumis and Umbra, and Strings possess the same rewards, but since they only spawn at Level 30, cards from the standard pool may also drop.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
